page_title: Rajendra P N - AWS DevOps Technical Mentor
headline: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer
summary_html: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer with 10 years of experience in cloud engineering, CI/CD automation, and production operations. Combines AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and troubleshooting with learner 1:1 sessions, technical presentations, group Q&A, and cross-team communication. Helps engineers understand deployment workflows, source-control standards, cloud dependencies, and operational diagnostics through practical guidance and reusable documentation. Builds Python/FastAPI automation and supports GPU-enabled Kubernetes and vector-search workloads, bringing applied AI-platform context to technical discussions.

achievements.text: Coaches development teams on Git workflows, branch governance, merge standards, and repeatable deployment practices.
Connects AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, CI/CD, container orchestration, monitoring, and production diagnostics to practical engineering use cases.
Creates deployment guides and runbooks and engineers GPU-enabled Kubernetes and vector-search platforms for AI application workloads.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Developed Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation for provisioning, platform support, and recovery workflows, reducing manual operational effort.
Architected reusable CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline and GitHub workflows to automate build, test, and release execution across engineering teams.
Designed Terraform-based EKS infrastructure for high-throughput vector search and GPU-enabled workloads, integrating repeatable provisioning with container delivery.
Managed self-hosted runners, build agents, and distributed deployment infrastructure to optimize pipeline throughput across controlled compute environments.

Established Git branching, approval, and artifact versioning standards and integrated DevSecOps controls into release workflows through secure secrets handling, Terraform validation, and pre-deployment policy checks across AWS environments.
Implemented secure service connectivity using AWS PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, and private networking controls to protect sensitive application traffic.
Standardized deployment pipelines for AWS and hybrid environments, improving release consistency, auditability, and operational reliability.
Directed release planning across engineering teams, aligning dependencies, change windows, delivery risks, and production support.
Coordinated incident response and production release support, minimizing downtime and accelerating service restoration during high-priority events.
Authored deployment guides, architecture documentation, and operational runbooks that explain provisioning prerequisites, release steps, validation, and recovery procedures for engineering teams.
Guided engineering teams through deployment workflows, environment dependencies, and operational runbooks, explaining implementation choices and troubleshooting steps.
Reviewed pipeline and infrastructure changes with engineers, connecting Git branching, validation checks, security controls, and release readiness to practical delivery scenarios.

Administered Kubernetes clusters and deployed applications through pods, deployments, services, and core platform components.

Improved Kubernetes release processes by standardizing deployment patterns, secure runner standards, controlled branch protections, container image validation, and pipeline checks across environments.
